name: Himemiya Yukari
source:
A first year high school student.
She sometimes has a hard time remembering things because of an accident she got into in middle school.
Because she holds a mysterious 'bewitching pyroxene' stone she has become involved in various disputes.
Her mom is named Mai, an elusive and mysteriously aged children's book writer.
